paper.abstract_en: This report reviews key developments in Carrollian physics with an emphasis on their role in the emerging framework of holography in asymptotically flat spacetimes. We begin by introducing the Carrollian limit, understood as a contraction of the Poincaré group obtained by formally taking the speed of light to zero. The geometric structures associated with this limit are described and argued to arise naturally on null hypersurfaces, most notably on null infinity, as well as black hole and cosmological horizons. Building on this, we examine the relation between the Bondi-Metzner-Sachs symmetries governing asymptotically flat gravity and the conformal Carrollian symmetries. Explicit examples of Carrollian field theories are constructed by implementing the limit on well-known relativistic field theories, with particular attention to Carrollian CFTs. We then present the Carrollian holography proposal, according to which gravity in asymptotically flat spacetimes is dual to a Carrollian CFT living at null infinity in one lower dimension. In this framework, the massless $\mathcal{S}$-matrix written in position space at null infinity is naturally reinterpreted in terms of boundary Carrollian CFT correlators, called Carrollian amplitudes. We highlight their relation to celestial amplitudes and show how they naturally emerge from holographic CFT correlators through a correspondence between the flat space limit in the bulk and the Carrollian limit at the boundary. Using this correspondence, we provide strong evidence that flat space holography arises from a controlled and consistent limiting procedure applied to both sides of the AdS/CFT duality. We conclude by outlining future directions and open questions in the program.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该综述聚焦于Carrollian物理及其在渐近平坦时空全息中的应用，与广义相对论基础及全息方向高度相关；摘要清晰阐述了Carrollian极限、BMS对称性、Carrollian CFT以及对偶提案，理论深度和方法论信号较强，且提出了从AdS/CFT受控极限导出平坦空间全息的证据，具有明显的新颖性。
decision.abstract_zh: 本报告综述了Carrollian物理的关键进展，重点强调其在渐近平坦时空新兴全息框架中的作用。我们首先引入Carrollian极限，将其理解为通过形式上将光速取为零而得到的庞加莱群收缩。我们描述了与该极限相关的几何结构，并论证它们自然地出现在零超曲面上，最显著的是在零无穷远以及黑洞和宇宙学视界上。在此基础上，我们考察了支配渐近平坦引力的Bondi-Metzner-Sachs对称性与共形Carrollian对称性之间的关系。通过对众所周知的相对论场论实施该极限，我们构造了Carrollian场论的具体例子，并特别关注Carrollian CFT。随后我们提出了Carrollian全息提案，根据该提案，渐近平坦时空中的引力对偶于生活在低一维零无穷远处的Carrollian CFT。在此框架中，在零无穷远处以位置空间写出的无质量$\mathcal{S}$-矩阵被自然地重新解释为边界Carrollian CFT关联函数，称为Carrollian振幅。我们强调了它们与天球振幅的关系，并展示了它们如何通过体时空中的平坦空间极限与边界上的Carrollian极限之间的对应关系，从全息CFT关联函数中自然涌现。利用这一对应关系，我们提供了强有力的证据，表明平坦空间全息源于对AdS/CFT对偶两侧施加的受控且一致的极限过程。最后，我们概述了该纲领的未来方向和开放问题。
